successes.name: group-snapshot-original-key
successes.text: SELECT 7 AS x, 9 AS y |> AS before |> SET x = y |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY before.x |> ORDER BY x

successes.name: group-snapshot-current-key
successes.text: SELECT 7 AS x, 9 AS y |> AS before |> SET x = y |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY x |> ORDER BY x

successes.name: group-sql-chain-computed-alias
successes.text: WITH t AS (SELECT 2 AS x, 10 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS x, 20 AS y) SELECT l.x + 1 AS y, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t AS l JOIN t AS r ON l.x = r.x JOIN t AS s ON r.x = s.x GROUP BY y HAVING y > 1 ORDER BY y

successes.name: group-pipe-chain-new-scope
successes.text: WITH t AS (SELECT 2 AS x, 10 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS x, 20 AS y) FROM t AS l |> JOIN t AS r ON l.x = r.x |> JOIN t AS s ON r.x = s.x |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY l.x |> SELECT x, n |> ORDER BY x

successes.name: group-empty-nullable-key
successes.text: SELECT CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS x WHERE FALSE |> AS before |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY before.x |> ORDER BY x

successes.name: group-acquired-shared-producer
successes.text: DATA seed = FROM records |> SELECT id; SELECT l.id AS id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM seed AS l JOIN seed AS r ON l.id = r.id JOIN seed AS s ON r.id = s.id GROUP BY id ORDER BY id

refusals.name: group-old-range
refusals.text: FROM records AS before |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY before.id |> SELECT before.id, n

refusals.name: group-old-range-after-set
refusals.text: FROM records AS before |> SET id = id + 1 |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY before.id |> SELECT before.id, n

refusals.name: group-nongrouped-sql-range
refusals.text: WITH t AS (SELECT 2 AS x, 10 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS x, 20 AS y) SELECT r.y, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t AS l JOIN t AS r ON l.x = r.x JOIN t AS s ON r.x = s.x GROUP BY l.x

refusals.name: group-dropped-input
refusals.text: FROM records AS before |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY id |> SELECT amount, n
